profile_dxf_importer.title: DXF Profile Importer
profile_dxf_importer.description: Import profile geometry from DXF files

overview.title: Tuning Overview
overview.description: Use the tabs on the right to calibrate cutting (K-factors), define machining zones, and validate production accuracy. Once you are confident, mark this profile as tuned.

alert.message: Tuning is per-profile and per-system. Repeat the process for each critical frame/sash profile in your ROCK 60, JUMBO 100, or Caluminium packs to reach Titanium‑grade reliability.

cutting_rules.title: Cutting, Joints & Scrap Policy
cutting_rules.border_allowance_desc: Used when frame has external borders (e.g. +5mm for plaster tolerance).
cutting_rules.joint_allowance_desc: Joint allowances are extra mm applied at each corner or joint before optimization. Use positive values to intentionally overshoot and let assembly trim; use 0 for "exact math".

glazing.title: Glazing Thickness, Gaskets & Packages
glazing.gasket_compression_desc: Typical values are 1.5–2.0mm for good sealing without crushing the gasket.
glazing.allowed_glass_desc: Used by the design engine to propose only compatible glass structures for this profile.
glazing.glazing_limits_desc: These limits are used to validate glass packages and prevent impossible glazing combinations for this profile (e.g. too thick IGU for the bead).

geometry.title: Geometry & Shape
geometry.description: Define archetype and key dimensions for procedural thumbnails (no CAD required).
geometry.scan_prompt: Have a catalog photo? Run SmartScan to ingest the profile outline and dimensions.

import_banner.title: SmartScan Import Ready
import_banner.message: Your scanned profile has been imported. Review the geometry below and adjust as needed. The vector has been saved as the profile's geometry configuration.

smartscan.title: SmartScan Import
smartscan.description: Upload catalog images, PDFs, or DXF files. SmartScan will vectorize and extract dimensions automatically.

structural.title: Structural Limits & Physics Class
structural.structural_notes_placeholder: e.g. Balcony door use only with reinforcement; wind zone C not recommended.
structural.limits_desc: These limits are used to warn when a window or frame dimension exceeds the safe span for this profile (based on supplier tables or your own experience).

hardware.title: Hardware Families & Packs
hardware.primary_lock_placeholder: e.g. multipoint A, sliding lock B
hardware.preferred_handle_placeholder: e.g. Alumil series X, generic lever
hardware.hardware_pack_desc: These tags will later map to predefined hardware & machining packs (hinges, locks, screws) for this profile.

cost_erp.title: Cost Model & ERP Mapping
cost_erp.cost_desc: These fields let the optimizer and reports estimate true production cost per meter for this profile, including coatings and machining.

machining.title: Machining Zones
machining.description: Define machining zones for this profile

summary.title: Tuning Status & Confidence
summary.description: This panel will surface calibration analytics and test results (cut deviations, confidence scores) as they accumulate over real jobs.

profile_import_tool.title: Smart Profile Import Tool
profile_import_tool.description: Import profiles from multiple formats with AI-powered K-factor learning

upload.title: Drop files here or click to upload

kfactor.description: AI-powered K-factor suggestions based on imported DXF/DWG measurements

precision.title: Precision Learning
precision.description: Learns from your actual measurements to improve suggestions

similarity.title: Similar Profile Matching
similarity.description: Finds similar profiles to suggest optimal K-factors

hints.title: Hints & Tips
hints.description: Provides reasoning for each K-factor suggestion

collective.title: Collective Learning
collective.description: Improves over time from production feedback

upload.title: Click or drag image to upload
upload.formats: Supported formats: JPG, PNG, BMP (export PDF/DWG/DXF to image)
upload.max_size: Max size: 10MB; one drawing at a time

scale.auto_detect_tooltip: AI will attempt to detect scale from dimension labels in the image
scale.manual_scale_example: Example: 0.1 means 1 pixel = 0.1 mm (common for engineering drawings)
scale.ai_active_desc: The system will attempt to detect scale from dimension labels. If successful, you'll be prompted to confirm.

scale_modal.title: Scale Detection Result
scale_modal.high_confidence: The AI detected a scale with high confidence. You can safely apply it automatically.
scale_modal.medium_confidence: The AI detected a scale with moderate confidence. Please verify the detected value before applying.
scale_modal.low_confidence: The AI detected a scale with low confidence. Manual verification is recommended.

errors.invalid_file_desc: Please upload an image file (JPG, PNG, etc.)
errors.no_file_desc: Please select an image file first
errors.svg_not_available_desc: SVG file URL not found in results
errors.no_scale_desc: AI could not detect a scale. Please enter scale manually.
errors.low_confidence_desc: AI detected a scale with low confidence. Please enter scale manually.
